core_findings.issue: SQLite context managers committed transactions without closing connections
core_findings.before: 27 of 27 held connections still executed SELECT 1 after teardown
core_findings.repair: Explicit contextlib.closing at every connection site

core_findings.issue: Repeated true findings inflated verified closures for one fixed defect
core_findings.before: One true case produced two verified closures and a positive paired closure delta
core_findings.repair: Deduplicate verified closures per case and count duplicate_verified_closures separately

core_findings.issue: Check digest did not bind all claimed fixture inputs and expected results
core_findings.before: Changing atomic first payload and expected_final left the check digest unchanged
core_findings.repair: Bind explicit database/stream fixture functions and observation/scheduling helpers

core_findings.issue: Numeric done marker was treated as boolean terminal success
core_findings.before: The fixed consumer accepted {"done":1} as completed
core_findings.repair: Require the terminal done value to be exactly the boolean True

core_findings.issue: Missing requested IDs were dropped from the independent batch oracle denominator
core_findings.before: Accurate partial success for requested IDs [1,999] was rejected
core_findings.repair: Preserve every requested ID in expected outcomes and validate unique boolean per-item results

core_findings.issue: Output was truncated only after unbounded subprocess capture
core_findings.before: 16 MiB child output used 50,372,860 traced parent bytes although only 8192 characters were returned
core_findings.repair: Enforce a shared 64 KiB stdout/stderr capture budget and terminate owned subprocesses on overflow or timeout

rejected: Claim that the public demo constitutes an agent-performance measurement
Interpretation of the synthetic credential URL negative test as an actual credential
Claim that original assertions were removed or weakened at the assertion-expression level
needs_validation: Final release commit and archive identities
Final reachable public history and unauthenticated readback
Redistribution rights and manual privacy review
limits: Offline scorer and regression helper consume supplied judgments and artifacts; hashes do not authenticate the underlying truth.
